head_commit.message:
launcher_test: ca canh bo loc "ket qua phai nam trong d" cua _ShutilWin311.which (#1375)

No ghi khi land #1345: nhanh Python 3.11 cua `_thuc_thi` chua co ca nao canh bo loc thu muc.

- Ca moi `r1375_shutilwin311_chi_nhan_trong_d`: goi thang lop lay tu `_tai_launcher_thu()`;
  (a) d rong, cwd tien trinh co tep cung ten => None; (b) d co tep => duong dan trong d;
  khoi phuc cwd trong finally va so cwd truoc/sau ngay trong ca.
- Dot bien moi `r1375_bo_loc_thu_muc` (bo bo loc, `return u`), ca dich la ca tren.

Do tai cho (Linux, Python 3.11.18 / 3.12.3 / 3.13.18): neutral `qua`; runner dot bien
`giet 1/1` tai ve (a); doi chung `return None` do tai ve (b). Chua do tren Windows.
